source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Once this model has finished shooting in your Shooting phase, pick one INFANTRY unit that its Agonising Energies hit at least once during that shooting. That unit counts as wracked with agonies until your next turn begins. While wracked with agonies, its Move characteristic is 2" lower and its Charge rolls get −2.

detail.when: your Shooting phase, after this model has shot
detail.duration: until start of your next turn
